tickets.title: conver.js ACP接続の信頼性修正
tickets.background: conver.js の ACP セッション確立に原因不明のバグがあり、claude-agent-acp との接続が「ACP connection closed」で失敗する。全く同じロジックのテストコード（acp-test.mjs）では接続は成功する。テスト実証済みのコードパターンに置き換えて問題を回避する。
scope: session.ts の spawnAgent/createSession/withSession/runCommand/disposeSession をテスト実証済みパターンに書き換え
conver.ts のグローバルエラーハンドラを全削除
acp-test.mjs を回帰テストとして保存
testUnit: node ./conver.js -k <key> -s <url> -c 1 -v 1 が1チケット以上処理完了
make test-conver 全テスト PASS
acp-test.mjs <key> 全15テスト PASS
testExceptions: claude-agent-acp との実結合テストはモック不可
acp-test.mjs を E2E テストとして手動実行
tickets.notes:
レビュー報告書: P-1-2 conver.js ACP接続の信頼性修正
---
【Step1】存在確認: ✅ P-1-2 存在、status=done
【Step2】チケットフィールド読取: ✅ スコープ・テスト計画・変更履歴を確認
【Step3】依存関係検証: ✅ PX-1 (reviewed) への依存整合性確認済、相互参照矛盾なし
【Step4】犯罪スキャン: ✅ 0件
【Step5】[::STUB::] スキャン: ✅ 0件
【Step6】不完全実装探索: ✅ 7パターン全て確認、問題なし
【Step7】コンパイル+テスト: ✅ make typecheck OK, make test-conver 56/56 PASS
【Step8】静的品質チェック: ✅ 0 issues
【Step9】翻訳可能性: ✅ 問題なし
---
総評: 全ての項目で問題なし。Acceptance Criteria を満たしている。
主な変更: connect() → connectWith() 置換、バイナリ探索関数追加、createSession 非公開化、proc.on(error) ハンドラ追加、disposeSession に connection.close() 追加。

tickets.title: query.js 改修 — headingRefs警告削除・エッジ重複除去バグ修正・関係一覧フォーマット改善
tickets.background: query.js は headingRefs 解決不能時に [WARN] を stderr に出力するが、PX-32 で test-query-all.js が全 headingRefs の解決可能性を exit code で保証するようになるため不要となる。また、multiHopBFS() の edgeSet がオブジェクト参照比較（new Set()）を行っているため、JSON パース後の同一内容エッジを重複除去できず、関係一覧に同一エッジが複数回出力されるバグがある。さらに、グループ見出しと各行で種別・強度が重複出力されるフォーマット上の無駄がある。

tickets.title: Normalize file paths in JSON outputs to home-directory-relative (~/) format
tickets.background:
### Goal
Normalize all file path outputs in JSON to home-directory-relative (~/) format, making them portable across machines without manual repair.

### Purpose
Currently paths stored in GRAPH.json, status JSONs, Dirs-Tree.json, and Tickets.json are either (a) raw relative strings like `RFC-ROOT.md` or (b) absolute paths with hardcoded `/Users/kawata/...`. When the same JSON is used on another machine (different username, different $HOME), absolute paths break and relative paths resolve incorrectly. By storing all paths as `~/...` and expanding on read, the same JSON works on any machine.

### Motivation
Real failure: `RFC-ROOT-GRAPHIFY-Status.json` contains `/Users/shyme/shyme/zasso/crates/siprs/RFC-ROOT.md` — a path from a different user account. This causes pipeline operations to fail silently when run on the current machine. Root cause: scripts use `path.resolve()` which embeds current machine absolute path without post-processing.

### Constraints
- Scope strictly limited to `tools/conver/.claude/` scripts — no changes to command `.md` files or external tooling
- Test code may be placed outside `.claude/` (e.g. tests/ directory)
- No new npm dependencies allowed
- Must use `os.homedir()` from Node.js standard library

tickets.notes:
### Implementation Steps
1. Create scripts/lib/path-utils.js with toHomeRelative() and fromHomeRelative()
2. Add require('./path-utils') to each writing-side script and wrap path assignments
3. Add require('./path-utils') to each reading-side script and wrap path reads with fromHomeRelative()
4. Write unit tests for path-utils.js
5. Write integration tests for write→read round-trips of each pipeline
6. Run full test suite: node tests/run-all.js

### Risks
Low risk — all changes are mechanical wrapping of existing path assignments. The functions are pure and have no side effects. Main risk is forgetting to update one of the 9 insertion points.

### Caveats
- path.resolve() does NOT expand ~ — reading scripts MUST call fromHomeRelative() before path.resolve()
- The 6 existing JSON files with stale `/Users/shyme/shyme/` paths will be repaired automatically the next time scripts are re-run (createDefaultStatus overwrites them)
- crud.js L63 stores raw --source= value; this is often a relative path (e.g. RFC-ROOT.md). toHomeRelative() applied to a relative path that doesn't contain /Users/... is a no-op, which is correct: relative paths remain relative.

### Open Items
None — all writing and reading insertion points identified.

### Future Improvements
Consider adding a `scripts/lib/path-utils.test.js` unit test file as part of this ticket.

### Translatability Improvements

1. **Extract shared path normalization into named utility functions**: Currently, 3 copies of createDefaultStatus() each contain inline `path.resolve(dir, basename + '.md')` — this violates DRY and makes the intent (file path derivation) inseparable from the resolution logic. After this fix, the intent is clear: `toHomeRelative(path.resolve(dir, basename + '.md'))` reads as "resolve to absolute, then normalize to portable form."

2. **Extract fromHomeRelative() into a named function on the reading side**: Both resolve-ticket-context.js and show-ticket-context.js have identical inline `path.resolve(ticketsDir, resolvedPaths.xxx)` patterns. Wrapping with `fromHomeRelative()` makes the path expansion intent explicit without adding comments.

3. **No further Boy Scout improvements needed**: The existing scripts already have clean function names (createDefaultStatus, readGraph, createEmptyGraph), good variable names (sourceFile, graphFile, rfcPath), and no deep nesting. The only translatability problem was the hidden assumption that `path.resolve()` output is portable across machines.

tickets.title: Implement code ticket-key annotation (Everything as Code extension)
tickets.background:
### Goal
start-ticket.md と review-ticket.md が生成する実装コードに、チケットキー注釈と show-ticket-context.js 参照コマンドを自動付記する仕組みを導入する。

### Purpose
コード自体が provenence（来歴）を語るようにする。実装コードを読むだけで「このコードはどのチケットで実装されたか」「元設計（RFCグラフノード）への参照パスは何か」が即座に分かる状態を作る。上流パイプライン（graphify-rfc → boundify-graph → split-to-tickets）が生成するグラフ構造へのトレーサビリティを、下流（make→plan→start→review）の出力に組み込む。

### Motivation
現在、start-ticket.md と review-ticket.md が生成するコードには、それがどのチケットの産物かという来歴情報が一切含まれていない。コードレビュー時に「この関数は何のチケットで追加されたのか」を git blame で遡る必要があり、トレーサビリティが低い。上流で生成されたグラフ構造を下流で活用できていない。

### Constraints
- コメント挿入は可能な限りスクリプトが機械的に行い、AI は曖昧ケースのみ補助する
- 同一ファイルに重複注釈を挿入しない（ノイズ爆発禁止）
- コメント挿入後もコードの構文が変化してはならない
- ファイル先頭ではなく、チケットが最初に触った意味定義の直上に挿入する
- 対応言語: .rs .go .ts .tsx .js .jsx .vue .py .rb .swift .kt .java .cs

tickets.title: Implement annotation merge for hot-spot functions
tickets.background:
### Goal
annotate-ticket-context-by-git-diff.js が同一定義に複数チケットから注釈を挿入するとき、常に1行にマージする。

### Purpose
ホットスポット（複数チケットが同一関数/定義を修正するケース）で注釈コメントが累積するのを防ぐ。1定義 = 1注釈行を維持し、コードの読みやすさを保つ。

### Motivation
現在、同一関数に PX-59, PX-61 の2チケットが注釈を入れると: PX-59挿入 → PX-61は既存注釈を検出してスキップ（チケットキー不一致のためスキップせず新規挿入になる）。結果として2行の verbose なコメントが積み上がる。これを「1行にマージ」に変える。

### Constraints
- マージはスクリプトが決定論的に行う（AI判断不要）
- 同一キーの再注釈は常にスキップ（冪等性）
- 単一チケットのみの注釈はフォーマット変更しない（後方互換性）
- マージ後も show-ticket-context.js の参照コマンドは有効であること

tickets.title: Implement scope detection engine (findContainingDefinition)
tickets.background:
The current annotate-ticket-context-by-git-diff.js injects annotations at the first definition in a file regardless of where the actual git diff changes occurred. This creates false provenance links — annotations are placed on code the ticket never touched.

A scope detection engine is required that can answer: 'which definition scope contains a given line number?' The engine must support:
- Brace depth tracking (for Rust, Go, TS/JS, C#, Java, Kotlin, Swift)
- Indentation-based fallback (for Python, Ruby)

This is Ticket-1 of 2 (PX-62 rewrites the annotation pipeline to consume this engine).

### Goal
Provide a pure-function module findContainingDefinition(lines, targetLine) that, given a source file's lines and a 0-indexed line number, returns the innermost definition (function/struct/class/enum/trait/impl/interface) that contains that line, or null if the line belongs to no definition.

### Purpose
Eliminate false provenance links caused by the current 'first-definition-in-file' heuristic. Every annotation must point to the actual definition the ticket changed, not an unrelated one higher in the file.

### Motivation
Current approach is architecturally broken: detectFirstDefinition() returns the first fn/class/struct in the file, which has zero correlation with the actual git diff changes. This violates the 'Comments must encode provenance' principle added to CLAUDE.md.

### Constraints
- Zero side effects: no fs, no git, no process, no network access
- 100% unit-testable with inline source snippets as input
- Must handle both brace-delimited languages (C family) and indentation-based languages (Python, Ruby)
- Must ignore braces inside strings, comments, and regex literals
- Must be a separate module (not inline in the main script) for PX-62 to import
- DEFINITION_PATTERNS and SOURCE_EXTENSIONS must be extracted into a shared constants module
- Reuse the existing 14 DEFINITION_PATTERNS regexes from annotate-ticket-context-by-git-diff.js line 39-54

[Change] Brace depth tracking: line-by-line scan tracking depth via `{`/`}` with string/comment/regex literal context awareness. When a DEFINITION_PATTERN matches at depth===currentDepth, record it as an active definition. When depth drops below the definition's starting depth, pop it. Return the innermost definition whose startDepth <= currentDepth <= endDepth and startLine <= targetLine.

tickets.title: Rewrite annotation injection to use changed-line-based definition targeting
tickets.background:
Currently annotateSourceFiles() uses git diff --name-only (file-level only) and processFile() calls detectFirstDefinition() which finds the first definition in the entire file. After PX-61 provides findContainingDefinition(), the annotation pipeline must be rewritten to:
1. Use git diff -U0 to obtain precise changed line numbers
2. Map each changed line to its containing definition via findContainingDefinition
3. Deduplicate definitions (multiple changed lines in the same function = 1 annotation)
4. Inject annotations at each containing definition's start line (not just the file's first definition)

This is Ticket-2 of 2, depending on PX-61.

### Goal
Rewrite annotateSourceFiles(), processFile(), and verifyAnnotations() to use changed-line-based definition targeting via findContainingDefinition, eliminating the current first-definition heuristic entirely.

### Purpose
Every annotation comment must be placed at the actual definition containing the changed lines, not at an unrelated definition. This is the core fix for false provenance links.

### Motivation
The current architecture (detectFirstDefinition) is fundamentally broken — it places annotations on code the ticket never touched. This violates the 'Comments must encode provenance' principle and must be fixed before any further ticket processing can rely on annotation accuracy.

### Constraints
- Must keep the existing CLI interface unchanged (--ticket-key, --verbose, --verify, --check-ambiguous)
- Must keep mergeAnnotation(), buildAnnotation(), insertAnnotation() unchanged (these are correct)
- Git diff -U0 parsing must handle unified diff format, new files, binary files, and renamed files
- Changed lines not containing any definition (e.g. import additions, const declarations) must fall back to [::AMBIGUOUS::]
- Existing exports (module.exports) must be preserved for testing

tickets.investigation:
- [Evidence gathered from source code analysis]

**Current git diff usage (annotateSourceFiles, lines 272-331):**
- Line 278-279: `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM` — only returns file names, no line numbers.
- Line 289-294: `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` — untracked files (new additions). For untracked files, ALL lines are effectively changed.

**What git diff -U0 outputs (example):**
```
diff --git a/src/foo.rs b/src/foo.rs
index abc123..def456 100644
--- a/src/foo.rs
+++ b/src/foo.rs
@@ -10,5 +10,7 @@ impl Foo {
     fn bar() {
-        old_line
+        new_line
+        another_new_line
     }
 }
```
The hunk header `@@ -10,5 +10,7 @@` means: old start 10 (5 lines), new start 10 (7 lines). The added lines are new lines 10-16 (7 lines starting from 10). Actually, in unified diff, +10,7 means 7 lines starting at line 10 in the new file. Among those 7, the lines that were originally present (context lines) + added lines = 7 total. The actual "changed" lines (added) are those prefixed with + (not ++). But for annotation purposes, we need ALL lines in the new file that are affected — both context and added lines, since context lines indicate the function was modified.

Actually, let me reconsider. For annotation, we want to annotate the definition if ANY line within it was touched. So we should collect all line numbers in the new file that appear in any hunk — both context and added lines. If a hunk is `@@ -10,5 +10,7`, then new file lines 10-16 (7 lines) are affected. We should check if any of those lines fall within a definition.

**Note on untracked files:** For untracked files, there's no git diff output. We must read the file's content and annotate ALL definitions in the file (since every line is "new"). This is the same behavior as the current "first definition" but now per-definition.

tickets.title: Fix detectAnnotationLine regex to match [::TICKET::] annotation format
tickets.background:
PX-62 rewrote buildAnnotation() and buildMultiAnnotation() to use [::TICKET::] format. However detectAnnotationLine() still uses old regex patterns that do not match the new format, causing mergeAnnotation() to fail on future runs. This gap means stacked duplicate annotations will accumulate on subsequent executions.

### Goal
Make detectAnnotationLine() correctly parse the new [::TICKET::] annotation format so that mergeAnnotation() can detect and merge existing annotations on future runs.

### Purpose
Prevent duplicate stacked annotations from accumulating every time the annotation script runs on a previously annotated function. The merge mechanism (mergeAnnotation) only works if detectAnnotationLine can parse the existing annotation.

### Motivation
PX-62 changed the output format to [::TICKET::] but forgot to update the parser. This is a regression: the annotation system no longer detects its own annotations. Every subsequent /start-ticket execution that touches the same function will stack a new annotation line instead of merging into the existing one.

### Constraints
- Must not change buildAnnotation() or buildMultiAnnotation() output format (already correct)
- Must not change detectAnnotationAtLine(), mergeAnnotation(), insertAnnotation() logic
- Must maintain backward compatibility with any existing annotations still in old format (though none should exist after PX-62 commit)
- 100% unit-testable with inline string inputs

tickets.title: Fix list-definitions output: Markdown with git diff context
tickets.background:
The current list-definitions outputs JSON with {success, definitions, ambiguousLine, ambiguousLineNumber}. This is useless for AI judgment because AI reads natural language, not structured data.

### Goal
Replace JSON output with Markdown containing git diff -U5 context + definitions table.

### Purpose
Give AI the information it actually needs: which lines changed (git diff) and where definitions are (table). AI reads the diff, decides which definition the changed lines belong to, picks the line number, and runs inject-at.

### Motivation
PX-64 shipped with a broken design. The list-definitions output was designed as machine-readable JSON, but the consumer is AI, not a machine. AI needs visual context, not structured fields.

### Constraints
- inject-at mode output must remain JSON (it is consumed programmatically by scripts, not by AI)
- Must reuse existing git diff infrastructure (execFileSync, not a new git wrapper)
- Output goes to stdout; errors to stderr
- Must handle files outside git repos gracefully

tickets.title: Schema Foundation — edge + ticket に contracts 必須フィールド追加
tickets.background:
### Goal
edge.schema.json と tickets-schema.json に contracts 必須フィールドを追加し、全パイプラインが契約情報を運搬できる基盤を確立する。validate-tickets.js と validate-edge-contracts.js により contracts の欠落を BLOCK する。

### Purpose
現在のエッジは type（depends_on / implements 等）と note（240文字制限）のみで関係性を表現。contracts 配列を必須とすることで全エッジ接続が明示的な事前条件・事後条件・不変条件を持つことが強制される。

### Motivation
contracts は全契約パイプラインの基盤。PX-67〜PX-71 の全チケットがこのスキーマに依存する。

### Constraints
- 後方互換不要。既存の全 GRAPH.json / Tickets.json は再生成
- contracts は必須（required）、空配列禁止（minItems:1）
- 既存エッジフィールド（from/to/type/attributes）は変更しない
- tickets-schema.json の additionalProperties: true は維持
scope: 【変更】.claude/scripts/rfc-graph/schema/edge.schema.json — properties に contracts 追加、required に contracts 追加。contracts は配列（minItems:1）、各要素は id(C000)/precondition/postcondition/invariant を必須。additionalProperties:false 維持。
【変更】.claude/scripts/tickets/tickets-schema.json — ticket 定義の required に contracts 追加。contracts は配列、各要素は id/sourceEdge/precondition/postcondition/invariant を必須。additionalProperties:true 維持。
【変更】.claude/scripts/lib/validate-tickets.js — arrayFields に contracts 追加。各契約要素の precondition/postcondition/invariant が非空文字列であることの検証ロジックを追加。
【新規】.claude/scripts/tickets/validate-edge-contracts.js — GRAPH.json の全エッジの contracts 配列をスキーマ検証。3-line error template で違反報告。exit 1 on failure。
【非スコープ】crud.js の update-edge への contracts 対応 — PX-67（annotate-contracts）で対応。このチケットはスキーマ定義と検証スクリプトのみ。
【影響範囲】crud.js create-edges — 将来的に contracts 必須化が必要だが PX-67 で対応。
acceptanceCriteria: **[Happy path]** edge.schema.json が Ajv コンパイル可能で contracts 必須スキーマとして動作。validate-tickets.js が contracts ありチケットを PASS。validate-edge-contracts.js が適正 GRAPH.json を PASS。
**[Error case]** contracts なし GRAPH.json → validate-edge-contracts.js が BLOCK（exit 1）。contracts なしチケット → validate-tickets.js が BLOCK（exit 1）。
**[Edge case]** contracts 空配列のエッジ → BLOCK。precondition/postcondition/invariant のいずれかが空文字 → BLOCK。contracts.id に重複 → BLOCK。
tickets.notes:
依存: なし。このチケットが全契約パイプラインの基盤となる。既存の全グラフ・全チケットがスキーマ違反になることを前提に、後方互換なしでの導入を決定済み。

- [Implementation steps] 1) edge.schema.json に contracts 定義と required を追加, 2) tickets-schema.json に contracts 定義と required を追加, 3) validate-tickets.js に contracts 検証ロジック追加, 4) validate-edge-contracts.js を新規作成, 5) 全ユニットテスト実行, 6) 既存 GRAPH.json / Tickets.json のスキーマ違反確認
- [Risks] Risk 1: crud.js create-edges が contracts なしエッジを許可し続ける（PX-67 まで許容するが検証スクリプトは新規エッジを拒否する）。Risk 2: 再生成されるまで既存パイプラインが動作しない（要: PX-67→PX-68→PX-71 完了後に全グラフ・全チケット再生成）。
- [Caveats] Caveat 1: additionalProperties:true を維持するため contracts 以外の未知フィールドは tickets-schema.json で許可される。Caveat 2: validate-edge-contracts.js は edge.schema.json の Ajv 検証とは独立して動作する（二重検証による安全性向上だがメンテコスト増加）。
- [Open items] Open 1: contracts.id の最大長を決めていない（C999 まで = 999契約。グラフ1つに1000契約超は非現実的）。
- [Future improvements] 1) contracts.id を C0000（4桁）に拡張するか検討。2) Ajv スキーマコンパイル結果をキャッシュしてパフォーマンス改善。

- 【Boundary invariant】contracts 配列の最小長は 1（空配列不許可）。precondition/postcondition/invariant の最小長は 1 文字（空文字不許可）。

tickets.title: merge-contracts-to-tickets + Gate L2 — チケット契約合成と閉包性検証
tickets.background:
### Goal
merge-contracts-to-tickets.js と verify-ticket-closure.js（Gate L2）を実装する。前者は GRAPH.json のエッジ契約をチケットに合成し、後者はチケット内閉包性とチケット間閉包性を機械検証する。

### Purpose
PX-67 で GRAPH.json に付与された contracts を、各チケットに自動合成する。合成時に内部閉包する契約はチケット外に露出せず、外部との契約連鎖のみをチケット.contracts に書き込む。

### Motivation
チケット.contracts がなければ、チケット間の契約依存関係を機械検証できない。split-to-tickets の後処理として自動合成することで、AI が手動で contracts を記述する負荷を排除する。

### Constraints
- merge-contracts-to-tickets.js は split-to-tickets の出力を変更するが、split 自体の Step 構造は変更しない
- チケット内で閉じる契約（source.postcondition→target.precondition が充足）はチケット外に露出しない
- verify-ticket-closure.js は BLOCK/PASS の二値判定。WARNING は出力しない。
scope: 【新規】.claude/scripts/tickets/merge-contracts-to-tickets.js — GRAPH.json の edges[].contracts と Tickets.json の tickets[].nodeIds を突合。各チケット内エッジの contracts を収集し、内部閉包契約（source.postcondition == target.precondition が同一チケット内で充足）を除外し、外部露出契約のみをチケット.contracts に atomic write する。内部閉包判定は文字列完全一致。

【新規】.claude/scripts/tickets/verify-ticket-closure.js — Gate L2 スクリプト。検証: (1) チケット内閉包性 — 内部エッジの全 postcondition→precondition 連鎖が閉じている, (2) チケット間閉包性 — relatedTicketIds に基づく先行チケット.postcondition → 依存チケット.precondition 連鎖, (3) 全 acceptanceCriteria が契約 ID を参照, (4) 全契約に最低1つの acceptanceCriteria。exit 1 on failure。3-line error template。
【変更】split-to-tickets.md（PX-71で実施）— verify-all-ticket-coverage 直前に merge-contracts + verify-ticket-closure 呼び出し追記。このチケットではスクリプト実装のみ。
【非スコープ】split-to-tickets の Step 構造変更（スクリプトは後処理として独立。split 自体は変更しない）。
【影響範囲】Tickets.json — merge-contracts 実行後、各チケットに contracts フィールドが追加される（additionalProperties:true によりスキーマ違反にならない）。
acceptanceCriteria: **[Happy path]** merge-contracts-to-tickets がチケット.contracts を正しく合成。verify-ticket-closure が PASS。
**[Error case]** チケット内閉包性違反 → BLOCK + 未充足エッジ一覧。チケット間閉包性違反 → BLOCK + 未充足チケット一覧。
**[Edge case]** チケットが1エッジのみ（= 全契約が外部露出）→ 正常動作。チケット間エッジなし → 自動 PASS。
tickets.notes:
依存: PX-67（GRAPH.json に contracts 付与済み）。
- [Implementation steps] 1) merge-contracts-to-tickets.js 実装, 2) verify-ticket-closure.js 実装, 3) UT 作成・実行, 4) 既存グラフ＋チケットで統合テスト
- [Risks] merge-contracts の内部閉包判定ロジックが複雑。source.postcondition と target.precondition の突合は文字列の部分一致ではなく完全一致で行う。
- [Caveats] sourceEdge はエッジの from→to 文字列。同一エッジに複数契約がある場合は連番 C001, C002 で識別。
tickets.invariants:
- 【Normal establishment】全チケットが contracts 配列を持ち、チケット内エッジの全 postcondition→precondition 連鎖が閉じている。チケット間エッジの全 postcondition→precondition 連鎖も閉じている。
- 【Invariant on error】merge-contracts 失敗時は Tickets.json への書き込みを行わない（atomic write）。verify-ticket-closure は読み取り専用。
- 【Internal state invariant】両スクリプトは副作用ゼロ。ファイル読み取り＋処理＋ファイル書き戻し（merge）／結果出力（verify）のみ。
- 【Boundary invariant】チケット内閉包契約は契約連鎖が完全一致すること。チケット間閉包契約は異なるフェーズ間のエッジに適用。

- 【Logging】両スクリプトとも stdout に JSON 結果。stderr に 3-line error template。
- 【Metrics】merge-contracts: 処理エッジ数・合成契約数・内部閉包除外数。verify-ticket-closure: 判定（PASS/BLOCK）・未充足エッジ数。

[Existing merge-contracts 設計]
- 入力: GRAPH.json（edges[].contracts） + Tickets.json（tickets[].nodeIds）
- チケット内エッジ: 同一チケットの nodeIds に含まれるノード間のエッジ
- チケット間エッジ: 異なるチケットの nodeIds に含まれるノード間のエッジ

- 外部露出契約: 内部閉包しない + チケット外のノードを参照するエッジの契約のみ

[Existing verify-ticket-closure 設計]

tickets.title: Gate L1 + Gate M — グラフ契約検証と make 段階整合性
tickets.background:
### Goal
2つのゲートスクリプトを実装する。verify-graph-contracts.js（Gate L1）は graphify 完了直後に全エッジの契約フォーマットを検証。verify-make-contracts.js（Gate M）は make-ticket 完了直後にチケット契約とテスト計画の整合性を検証。

### Purpose
Gate L1: グラフレベルの契約—全エッジが contracts を持ち、そのフォーマットが正しいことを graphify 完了直後に保証する。Gate M: チケットレベルの契約—make-ticket で作成された spec の testUnit/testIntegration がチケット契約に言及していることを保証する。

### Motivation
Gate L1 がなければ不正な contracts フォーマットが下流（PX-68 以降）に流れるリスクがある。Gate M がなければ spec 作成時点で契約とテスト計画の乖離が放置される。

### Constraints
- 両ゲートとも読み取り専用（Tickets.json / GRAPH.json を変更しない）
- BLOCK/PASS の二値判定。WARNING は出力しない。
- 既存の status.json 制御（start-step / end-step / reset-to-step）を利用。ゲート FAIL 時は fail-step 遷移。
scope: 【新規】.claude/scripts/tickets/verify-graph-contracts.js — Gate L1 スクリプト。検証: (1) 全エッジに contracts[] 存在, (2) 全 precondition/postcondition/invariant 非空, (3) contracts.id 重複チェック, (4) type-contract 矛盾（depends_on/constrains なのに contracts 空は矛盾。references/refines は許容）。exit 1 on failure。

【新規】.claude/scripts/tickets/verify-make-contracts.js — Gate M スクリプト。検証: (1) 全 precondition が testUnit にキーフレーズ「setup」「前提」で言及, (2) 全 postcondition が testUnit に「assert」「確認」で言及, (3) 全 invariant が testUnit に「不変」で言及, (4) testExceptions 各項目に「テスト不能理由」と「設計欠陥でない理由」の両方のキーフレーズ存在。exit 1 on failure。
【変更】graphify-rfc.md（PX-71で実施）— Step 2 完了ブロックに verify-graph-contracts.js 呼び出し追記。
【変更】make-ticket.md（PX-71で実施）— Step 6 status=made 直前に verify-make-contracts.js 呼び出し追記。
【非スコープ】Gate L1 と verify-contracts-format.js（PX-67）の重複 — format.js はスキーマ検証、L1 は type-contract 矛盾の高次検証。役割が異なるため両方維持。
acceptanceCriteria: **[Happy path]** Gate L1 が全エッジ正常で PASS。Gate M が全チケット正常で PASS。
**[Error case]** precondition空文字 → Gate L1 BLOCK。testUnit未カバー契約 → Gate M BLOCK。
**[Edge case]** type-contract 矛盾（depends_on なのに空）→ Gate L1 BLOCK。type 不明なエッジ → Gate L1 の検証対象外。testExceptions 説明不足 → Gate M BLOCK。
tickets.notes:
依存: PX-67（GRAPH.json に contracts 必要）, PX-68（チケット.contracts 必要）。
- [Implementation steps] 1) verify-graph-contracts.js 実装, 2) verify-make-contracts.js 実装, 3) 全 UT 作成・実行, 4) 不正データでの BLOCK 確認
- [Risks] verify-make-contracts の testExceptions 正当性判定はキーフレーズ一致に依存。テストデータで偽陽性・偽陰性がないことを確認。
- [Caveats] Gate L1 は verify-contracts-format.js と役割が異なる（format.js = スキーマ検証、L1 = type-contract 矛盾等の高次検証）。
tickets.invariants:
- 【Normal establishment】Gate L1: 全エッジの contracts フォーマットがスキーマ適合。Gate M: 全テスト計画がチケット契約に言及。
- 【Invariant on error】ゲート FAIL 時も GRAPH.json / Tickets.json は一切変更されない。
- 【Internal state invariant】両スクリプトは副作用ゼロ。ファイル読み取り＋検証＋結果出力のみ。
- 【Boundary invariant】空の contracts（minItems 違反）・空文字 precondition は BLOCK。

tickets.title: Gate S — TDD Red @verifies 強制（verify-red-coverage.js）
tickets.background:
### Goal
verify-red-coverage.js（Gate S）を実装する。TDD Red フェーズ終了時に、テストコード内の @verifies 注釈を収集し、チケット.contracts の全契約 ID がテストでカバーされていることを機械検証する。Supreme Law §1.1（RED必須）を機械的に強制する。

### Purpose
TDD Red で書かれるテストコードが、宣言された契約を本当にカバーしているかを機械検証する。「テストを書いたつもり」と「契約がテストされたこと」の乖離を防ぐ。

### Motivation
Supreme Law は「テストを先に書け」と命じているが、現在それを強制する仕組みがない。@verifies 注釈によるトレーサビリティ強制は、契約がテストに変換されたことを可視化し、未カバーの契約を BLOCK する。

### Constraints
- @verifies 注釈は Rust: // @verifies C001、TypeScript: // @verifies C001 の形式。単一テスト関数に複数行の @verifies を許可。
- ファイルスキャンは正規表現ベース（@verifies\s+(C\d+)）。AST 解析は行わない。
- precondition/テスト setup、invariant/assertion の対応はコメントベースの近似判定。完全なコード解析は行わない。
scope: 【新規】.claude/scripts/tickets/verify-red-coverage.js — Gate S スクリプト。検証: (1) チケット.contracts の全 id が @verifies 注釈でテストファイルに出現（正規表現 /@verifies\s+(C\d+)/g）, (2) precondition→ @requires での setup 言及, (3) invariant→ @assert-invariant での assertion 言及, (4) カバレッジ < 100% → BLOCK + 未カバーID一覧。@verifies にチケット未登録の id → WARNING。exit 1 on failure。
【変更】start-ticket.md（PX-71で実施）— Red フェーズ終了判定に verify-red-coverage.js 呼び出し追記。Green 遷移条件に加える。
【非スコープ】テストコードの正しさ検証（@verifies 注釈の存在確認のみ。テスト内容の正しさまでは検証しない）。

- 正規表現: /@verifies\s+(C\d+)/g

tickets.title: Gate R + Pipeline Integration — 最終検証と既存コマンドへのゲート参照追加
tickets.background:
### Goal
verify-final-contracts.js（Gate R）を実装し、review-ticket 終了時に全ゲート通過記録を確認・契約充足率をレポートする。同時に graphify-rfc.md / split-to-tickets.md / make-ticket.md / start-ticket.md / review-ticket.md の5つのコマンド定義ファイルに、各ゲートスクリプトの呼び出しを最小限の改修で追記する。

### Purpose
全6チケットの最終統合。契約レイヤーの全ゲート（L1/L2/M/S/R）を既存パイプラインに結びつけ、graphify から review まで一貫した契約検証の流れを確立する。

### Motivation
各ゲートスクリプトの存在だけではパイプラインに統合されない。各コマンド定義ファイル（.md）に呼び出しを追記し、AI が graphify → split → make → start → review の各段階で自動的に契約検証を実行するようにする必要がある。

### Constraints
- 各コマンドの既存 Step 構造（Step 0〜N）は一切変更しない
- ゲート呼び出しは Step 成功完了ブロックの末尾に追記するのみ
- ゲート FAIL 時は既存の Error Recovery 手順（fail-step → reset-to-step）と同一パターンを使用
- boundify-graph.md と plan-ticket.md は変更しない
scope:
【変更】graphify-rfc.md — Step 2 完了ブロック（298-301行）に以下3スクリプトを挿入（end-step 2 と cleanup の間）:
```bash
# Step 2 successful completion (update progress status to running)
node .claude/scripts/rfc-graph/update-step-status.js --graphify-status="$statusPath" start-step 2

# Generate edge JSON and inject it into the graph file via crud.js
node .claude/scripts/rfc-graph/crud.js --graph="$graphPath" create-edges --file=_temp_edges.json

# === Gate L1: Annotate contracts + verify ===
# Annotate each edge with contract information (precondition/postcondition/invariant)
node .claude/scripts/rfc-graph/annotate-contracts.js "$1"

# Verify contracts format (schema compliance of each contract)
node .claude/scripts/rfc-graph/verify-contracts-format.js --graph="$graphPath"

# Verify graph-level contract consistency (Gate L1)
node .claude/scripts/tickets/verify-graph-contracts.js --graph="$graphPath"
# === Gate L1 end ===

# Step 2 successful completion (update progress status to done and advance currentStep to 3)
node .claude/scripts/rfc-graph/update-step-status.js --graphify-status="$statusPath" end-step 2

# Clean up temporary files
node .claude/scripts/rfc-graph/update-step-status.js --graphify-status="$statusPath" cleanup
```
Step 構造変更なし。3つのコマンドブロックを create-edges と end-step 2 の間に追加するのみ。ゲート FAIL 時は既存の reset-to-step 2 手順を使用。

【変更】split-to-tickets.md — Step 5-2 完了ブロック（506-511行）の verify-all-ticket-coverage 直前に以下を挿入:
```bash
# === Gate L2: Merge edge contracts into tickets + verify closure ===
# Merge graph edge contracts into each ticket's contracts array
node .claude/scripts/tickets/merge-contracts-to-tickets.js "$TICKETS_PATH" "$GRAPH_PATH"

# Verify ticket-level contract closure (Gate L2)
node .claude/scripts/tickets/verify-ticket-closure.js --tickets="$TICKETS_PATH" --graph="$GRAPH_PATH"
# === Gate L2 end ===

# Verify that ticketization of all phases is complete
node .claude/scripts/tickets/verify-all-ticket-coverage.js "$TICKETS_PATH"
```
既存の verify-all-ticket-coverage 呼び出しは残し、その直前に2スクリプトを追加。エラーリカバリは既存の reset-to-step 5-2 を使用。

【変更】make-ticket.md — Step 6 完了ブロック（line 242-250）、status=made 更新（line 248-250）の直前に以下を挿入:
```bash
# === Gate M: Verify make-stage contract consistency ===
node .claude/scripts/tickets/verify-make-contracts.js --ticket-key="$ARGUMENTS" --tickets="Tickets.json"
# === Gate M end ===

echo '{"status":"made"}' | node ".claude/scripts/tickets/update-ticket.js" "Tickets.json" "$ARGUMENTS"
```
spec 出力（show-ticket-context.js --for-spec）の完了後、status=made 更新の前に Gate M を挿入。FAIL 時は Step 6 を再実行（spec 修正 → 再検証）。

【変更】start-ticket.md — Step 7 冒頭（line 246-247、テスト実行前に）に以下を挿入:
```bash
### Step 6b: Verify Red contract coverage (Gate S)

Before proceeding to Green (implementation), verify that all declared contracts in the ticket
have corresponding @verifies annotations in the test files.

```bash
# === Gate S: Verify @verifies coverage for all contracts ===
node .claude/scripts/tickets/verify-red-coverage.js --ticket-key="$ARGUMENTS" --test-dir="src/"
# === Gate S end ===

If BLOCKed: return to Step 5 (Red) and add missing @verifies annotations to test files,
then re-run Gate S.
```

既存の Step 7 は Step 6b の後に番号シフト（既存の numbering は変更。Step 7→8, 8→9, quality check→10, review→11）。新たな sub-step として挿入。

【変更】review-ticket.md — Step 11（Transition to reviewed, line 279-285）の直前に以下を挿入:
```bash
### Step 10b: Verify final contract fulfillment (Gate R)

Before transitioning to reviewed, verify that all gates (L1/L2/M/S) have been passed
and that the contract fulfillment rate is 100%.

```bash
# === Gate R: Verify final contract fulfillment ===
node .claude/scripts/tickets/verify-final-contracts.js --ticket-key="$ARGUMENTS" --tickets="Tickets.json"
# === Gate R end ===

If BLOCKed: review the gate failure report and fix the underlying issue before re-running.
```

既存の Step 11 は Step 11（変更なし）。Step 10（Save review report）と Step 11 の間に Gate R を挿入。既存の check-final セクション内の Verification criteria にも「契約充足率 100%」を追加（line 148 に 9つ目の criteria として追記）。

【新規】.claude/scripts/tickets/verify-final-contracts.js — Gate R 検証スクリプト。検証項目: (1) Gate L1/L2/M/S の通過記録確認（L1=graphify status currentStep≥3, L2=split status currentStep≥6, M=ticket status≥made, S=@verifies 注釈存在確認）, (2) 全 acceptanceCriteria が PASS, (3) 契約充足率レポート（全契約中 N% 充足 / M% 未充足 / 理由）, (4) チケット間契約一貫性（チケット.contracts precondition/postcondition が隣接チケットと整合）。exit 1 on failure。3-line error template。
【非スコープ】graphify-rfc.md の Step 0/1/3/4/5 — 変更なし。Step 2 完了ブロック内にのみゲート追加。
【影響範囲】start-ticket.md の Step 番号 — Gate S（Step 6b）追加により既存 Step 7〜8 の番号が 8〜9 にシフト。countinue ブロックは手動修正が必要。
acceptanceCriteria: **[Happy path]** 全5コマンドファイルにゲート呼び出しが追記され、全ゲート PASS で review まで完了。verify-final-contracts が契約充足率 100% をレポート。
**[Error case]** Gate L1 未通過 → graphify-rfc.md の reset-to-step 2 でリカバリ。Gate M 未通過 → make-ticket.md の reset-to-step 6 でリカバリ。各ゲート FAIL 時に既存リカバリ手順が干渉なく動作。
**[Edge case]** 全ゲート通過しているが契約充足率が 100% 未満 → Gate R で BLOCK + 未充足契約 ID 一覧。check-final criteria に追加された「契約充足率 100%」で最終判断。

tickets.title: plan-ticket: mandate contract-to-test-code translation with Gate P verification
tickets.background:
### Goal
Plan-ticket must force each Contract's Precondition/Postcondition/Invariant into concrete test code in the plan — not just described at spec level.

### Purpose
Close the gap where make-ticket Phase 1.5 defines contract-to-testable-form mapping but plan-ticket has no symmetric enforcement, leaving contract-to-test-code translation unverified until start-ticket's Gate S.

### Motivation
PX-73 added mandatory Contracts definition mechanism to make-ticket (Phase 1.5 + Gate M). The downstream plan-ticket must have symmetric enforcement to maintain the pipeline invariant: make (spec-level contract -> testable form) -> plan (testable form -> concrete test code) -> start (test code -> @verifies annotation). Without this, plans can pass with vague 'comprehensive testing' language but no actual contract-to-test-code mapping.

### Constraints
Must integrate into existing plan-ticket.md workflow without changing Tickets.json schema (no new fields). Scripts must be plain Node.js (no new npm dependencies). Gate P must verify concrete test code patterns (assert_eq!, assert!, expect, should, etc.), not just keyword overlap.

tickets.title: Separate plan-level test code into dedicated planTestCode field
tickets.background:
### Goal
Make the distinction between spec-level testUnit entries and plan-level test code mechanical (script-enforced), not convention-based (AI discipline).

### Purpose
Currently plan-ticket Phase 1.5 appends concrete test code to testUnit via --append, mixing spec-level prose entries and code-level entries in the same array. There is no way for show-ticket-context.js, Gate P, or downstream tools to programmatically distinguish the two levels. A dedicated planTestCode field solves this: make-ticket writes testUnit, plan-ticket writes planTestCode, and each tool reads the correct source.

### Motivation
During PX-74 review, it was identified that plan-ticket Phase 1.5 appends test code to testUnit, creating a heterogeneous array. The user explicitly rejected a prefix-convention-based approach (AI discipline), requiring a mechanical script-level solution instead.

### Constraints
Must not change existing Tickets.json behavior — tickets without planTestCode must work unchanged. update-ticket.js already supports arbitrary fields via stdin JSON. No schema validation change needed (Tickets.json has no $schema).

tickets.background:
- 【Goal】Prevent orphaned and unresolved STUB markers from accumulating in the codebase by adding machine-verifiable gates at each pipeline phase
- 【Purpose】Provide 3 new scripts (validate-stub-format.js, enumerate-ticket-targets.js, validate-ticket-targets.js) that together enforce STUB marker format compliance, detect unresolved stubs as crimes, and validate structural completeness of targetStubs/targetCrimes in Tickets.json
- 【Motivation】Grill session (2026-07-28) discovered 139 unresolved STUB markers in siprs crate despite all tickets marked done. Root cause: no script enforced STUB resolution at any phase of the make-plan-start-review-resolve pipeline.
- 【Constraints】No changes to conver.js/runner.ts/session.ts; no changes to existing verify-*-contracts.js scripts; minimal additions to command definition markdown files (only script calls + loop instructions); all logic in new JavaScript scripts

tickets.title: stderr AI指示改善とresolve-ticket.mdラベル修正
tickets.background:
exit 1時にstderrでAIへの指示を英語で出力する改善（validate-stub-format.js, enumerate-ticket-targets.js, validate-ticket-targets.js）。resolve-ticket.md の 'Directory-scoped scans' ラベルを 'Full scan' に修正。

### Goal
All 3 validation scripts stderr output on exit 1 must tell the AI what to do next in English, not just describe the error.

### Purpose
When a validation script exits 1, the AI reads stderr to decide the next action. Without explicit Action instructions, the AI may guess wrong or loop inefficiently.

### Motivation
Usage data shows AI agents can waste turns on incorrect recovery when stderr only reports the error without prescribing the fix.

### Constraints
1. Zero logic changes to validation functions themselves. 2. All 83 existing tests must pass unchanged. 3. Output format consistency across all 3 scripts.

tickets.title: Fix lying comment in validate-ticket-targets.js and synchronize Malfeasance.json ↔ Tickets.json targetCrimes
tickets.background:
### Goal
Eliminate the lying comment in validate-ticket-targets.js and ensure Malfeasance.json ↔ Tickets.json targetCrimes are always consistent

### Purpose
Code integrity: a comment that claims to invoke scripts it does not call is a "lying comment" that violates the project's "Comments must not lie" rule. Crime synchronization ensures that the two crime storage systems do not diverge, which would cause crimes to disappear from one view.

### Motivation
Discovered during pipeline inspection 2026-07-28. The lying comment is a direct violation of the project's non-negotiable rules. The desynchronization risk means a crime recorded via malfeasance-create.js might never appear in targetCrimes, bypassing the validate-ticket-targets.js 8-item validation checks.

### Constraints
- The existing CLI interface of validate-ticket-targets.js must not change
- The synchronization must not modify Tickets.json targetCrimes (read-only from sync's perspective)
- The sync must be idempotent: repeated calls produce identical state

tickets.title: Safe field overwrite warning in update-ticket.js
tickets.background:
- 【Goal】Add a non-blocking safety warning when update-ticket.js overwrites a non-empty field without --append
- 【Purpose】Prevent an honest but forgetful AI from accidentally destroying existing field content (notes, instrumentation, etc.)
- 【Motivation】update-ticket.js defaults to full overwrite mode. A user who intends to append but forgets --append will silently erase data. The script currently gives no indication this happened.
- 【Constraints】Must not change stdout JSON format. Must not change exit codes. Warning must go to stderr only.
scope: update-ticket.js: add console.error WARNING when overwriting a non-empty string field without --append
Before: Overwriting notes='docstring' with notes='' → no notification to user
After: Same operation → [WARNING] 'Field "notes" already has content (9 chars). Use --append to concatenate.' on stderr, exit 0
Exit codes unchanged (0 on success, 1 on failure)
stdout JSON output format unchanged
No schema, config, or dependency changes
All callers unaffected — warning goes to stderr, none parse stderr programmatically
Non-change: Array fields are not warned (append semantics are different)
Non-change: --append mode behavior is untouched
testUnit: UT: [Normal] Overwrite non-empty string field without --append → stderr has [WARNING] with 'Use --append' instruction
UT: [Normal] Overwrite empty string field without --append → no warning on stderr
UT: [Normal] Use --append on non-empty field → no warning (append is intentional)
UT: [Edge] Overwrite non-empty array field → no warning (arrays have different semantics)
testExceptions: Cannot test stderr snapshot deterministically — use child process spawning. Not a defect — stderr is an output stream.
Cross-platform line endings make exact match fragile. Not testable deterministically. Not a defect — CLI output variation is inherent.
Child process capture is the correct approach. Not testable with unit assertions. Not a defect — integration tests handle this.
acceptanceCriteria: [Happy] Overwriting a non-empty string field without --append prints [WARNING] to stderr, exit 0
[Happy] Overwriting an empty field has no warning
[Happy] Using --append on a non-empty field has no warning
[Edge] All existing tests/behavior unchanged

test overwrite

- 【Normal】Overwriting a non-empty string field emits [WARNING] to stderr, exit 0
- 【On error】Function never throws on this condition — warning is advisory, not blocking
- 【Internal state】Empty field overwrite or --append usage produce no warning
- 【Boundary】Edge case: field exists but is empty string '' → treated as empty (no warning)

Verify stdout JSON has same structure before and after (success: true, ticketKey, updated fields)
No special prerequisites

tickets.investigation: update-ticket.js L40-54: the key logic is at line 40 (if appendFlag) vs line 53 (else — overwrite). The overwrite path does `p.tickets[i] = { ...p.tickets[i], ...safe }` — no check on whether the existing field has content. The stdin JSON body can include arbitrary fields, all passed through safe after stripping id/phaseId.

tickets.title: Error hint enhancement for malfeasance management scripts
tickets.background:
- 【Goal】Add stderr hint lines to malfeasance-create.js, malfeasance-update.js, malfeasance-delete.js for common error paths
- 【Purpose】When an honest AI encounters an error from a malfeasance script, the plain JSON response doesn't tell them what to do next. A one-line stderr HINT with a remediation command example fills this gap.
- 【Motivation】malfeasance scripts output only JSON to stdout (via output() helper). Unlike verify-* gate scripts which emit [ERROR]/Cause/Action to stderr, there's no human-readable guidance for AI troubleshooting.
- 【Constraints】stdout JSON output must remain identical (backward compat for automation). HINT goes to console.error (stderr) only. Exit codes unchanged.
scope: malfeasance-create.js: add console.error HINT after duplicate record error ('Use: node malfeasance-get.js N to inspect')
malfeasance-update.js: add console.error HINT after invalid field error ('Allowed fields: status, resolved_by_ticket, note')
malfeasance-update.js: add console.error HINT after invalid status error ('Allowed: open, resolved, false_positive')
malfeasance-delete.js: add console.error HINT after 'Record not found' error ('Use: node malfeasance-all.js to list records')
No changes to stdout JSON — output() calls remain as-is
No changes to exit codes or success paths
No changes to schema validation or record processing logic
All 3 scripts follow same pattern: console.error('HINT: ...') after output() on error
No dependency, config, or API changes
testUnit: UT: [Normal] malfeasance-create duplicate error → stdout unchanged, stderr contains HINT with 'malfeasance-get'
UT: [Normal] malfeasance-update invalid field error → stderr contains HINT listing allowed fields
UT: [Normal] malfeasance-update invalid status error → stderr contains HINT listing allowed statuses
UT: [Normal] malfeasance-delete not-found error → stderr contains HINT with 'malfeasance-all'
UT: [Edge] malfeasance-create success path → no HINT on stderr
testExceptions: Cannot test stderr output without child process spawning — stdout JSON is the testable contract. This is not a defect — stderr is advisory.
stderr is an output stream, not a return value. Not testable in unit frameworks. This is not a defect — stream-based I/O is inherent.
Integration test redirects stderr to file. Not testable with assertions alone. This is not a defect — integration is the correct level.
acceptanceCriteria: [Happy] malfeasance-create duplicate error outputs HINT to stderr, stdout JSON unchanged
[Happy] malfeasance-update field error outputs HINT to stderr with allowed field names
[Happy] malfeasance-update status error outputs HINT to stderr with allowed statuses
[Happy] malfeasance-delete not-found error outputs HINT to stderr
[Edge] Non-error paths produce no stderr HINT
tickets.notes:
- Step 1: In malfeasance-create.js, after output() on line 63, add console.error('HINT: Use node malfeasance-get.js N to inspect the existing record')
- Step 2: In malfeasance-update.js, after output() on line 51, add console.error with allowed fields list
- Step 3: In malfeasance-update.js, after output() on line 91, add console.error with allowed statuses
- Step 4: In malfeasance-delete.js, after output() on line 55, add console.error with malfeasance-all hint
- Risk: None — console.error is non-blocking and doesn't affect stdout or exit code
- Caveat: Ensure hints don't accidentally reveal sensitive data (they don't — they only reference other node scripts)
- Open: None
- Future: Could automate integration test for stderr content in a follow-up
Implementation summary:
- Changed files: malfeasance-create.js (4 HINT lines), malfeasance-update.js (5 HINT lines), malfeasance-delete.js (3 HINT lines)
- New test: malfeasance-hint.test.js (6 tests)
- Key change: added console.error('HINT: ...') after each error output() call
- Test results: all 10 test files passed
- Quality checks: 0 issues
tickets.invariants:
- 【Normal】Each common error path in malfeasance scripts (duplicate, invalid field, not found) emits one HINT line to stderr
- 【On error】Error JSON to stdout is unchanged — hint is additive only
- 【Internal state】Hint content is deterministic per error type
- 【Boundary】Non-error paths (success) produce no hint

IT: Run each script with valid arguments, confirm stdout unchanged
No special prerequisites
Related: PX-84 (error message quality theme)
tickets.instrumentation: No instrumentation changes — these are CLI scripts.
tickets.investigation: malfeasance-create.js L59-66: duplicate detection path outputs JSON error with id/file/line but no hint on what to do (skip, or use malfeasance-get to verify). malfeasance-update.js L48-53: invalid field error, no hint on allowed fields. malfeasance-delete.js L54-56: 'Record not found' with no hint on how to list records. All 3 scripts use output() (= console.log) for errors — hints will go to console.error.
tickets.boyScoutPlan: Boy Scout: Consider unifying the 3 scripts' error handling under a shared pattern in a follow-up ticket. For now, add one-line hints per script.

tickets.title: Ticket status visibility and command guidance improvements
tickets.background:
- 【Goal】Add targetStubs/targetCrimes visibility to show-ticket-context output, and a concrete command example to start-ticket.md Step 4
- 【Purpose】Reduce the information lookup burden on an honest AI: (1) ticket display should include stub/crime counts so the AI can see at a glance whether a ticket has residual STUB debt; (2) start-ticket.md Step 4 should give a concrete command to find resolvable STUBs so the AI doesn't have to craft it from scratch.
- 【Motivation】show-ticket-context.js displays status, scope, contracts, but not targetStubs/targetCrimes. The AI must separately inspect Tickets.json or run find-all-stubs.js. start-ticket.md Step 4 says 'Identify stubs that have become resolvable' but gives no command example — the AI has to stop and think about what command to run.
- 【Constraints】Spec file output (--for-spec) must remain unchanged — target display is for interactive use only. Command example must be copy-paste executable.
scope: show-ticket-context.js: add ## Target Status section after Pipeline Context, showing targetStubs count and targetCrimes count when fields exist
start-ticket.md Step 4: add concrete command example for finding resolvable stubs
Before: show-ticket-context output has 'Pipeline Context' as last section → After: 'Target Status' appears after it (when data exists)
Before: start-ticket.md Step 4 has only prose description → After: includes  concrete command
No schema, config, dependency changes
Non-change: --for-spec output unchanged (targetStubs are internal tracking, not spec content)
Non-change: No new CLI arguments or modes
testUnit: UT: [Normal] show-ticket-context outputs ## Target Status with counts when targetStubs/targetCrimes exist
UT: [Edge] show-ticket-context omits ## Target Status when neither field exists on the ticket
acceptanceCriteria: [Happy] show-ticket-context (non-spec mode) shows ## Target Status with counts when data exists
[Happy] start-ticket.md Step 4 includes a copy-paste command example for resolvable stub search
[Edge] Ticket without targetStubs/targetCrimes → no ## Target Status section
tickets.notes:
- Step 1: In show-ticket-context.js, locate the Pipeline Context rendering (L685 area). Add a similar block for Target Status that checks ticket.targetStubs and ticket.targetCrimes
- Step 2: Render as: ## Target Status
- targetStubs: N items (pending/resolved/false_positive)
- targetCrimes: N items
- Step 3: In start-ticket.md, locate Step 4 bullet list. Add after bullet 2: A concrete command example
- Risk: show-ticket-context.js is 738 lines — ensure the new section is added in the right position (after Pipeline Context, before EOF)
- Caveat: --for-spec mode must NOT include the Target Status section (it's operational, not spec content)
- Open: None
- Future: Consider a separate 'ticket status' page/command that aggregates all operational state
Implementation summary:
- Changed files: show-ticket-context.js (Target Status section +10 lines), start-ticket.md (command example +3 lines)
- New test: show-ticket-context-target-status.test.js (3 tests)
- Key changes: conditionally rendered ## Target Status in non-spec mode; concrete command example for resolvable stub search
- Test results: all 11 test files passed
- Quality checks: 0 issues
tickets.invariants:
- 【Normal】show-ticket-context displays ## Target Status section when either targetStubs or targetCrimes exist on the ticket
- 【On error】No display change — if ticket object is malformed, existing graceful handling applies
- 【Internal state】Section content is derived from the ticket object, not from external data sources
- 【Boundary】No targetStubs/targetCrimes field on ticket → no ## Target Status section
testIntegration: IT: Run show-ticket-context --ticket-key=PX-84, verify ## Target Status section appears with non-zero counts
IT: Run show-ticket-context on a ticket without targetStubs field, verify no ## Target Status section
No special prerequisites
Related: PX-84, PX-85, PX-86 (tracked by this ticket's targetStubs)
testExceptions: Cannot test markdown documentation changes with automated assertions. This is not a defect — human review is correct for docs.
Testing rendered markdown requires a parser. Not testable without over-engineering. This is not a defect — documentation changes are manually verified.
Command example correctness is verified by manual execution. Not testable in CI. This is not a defect — the example is a shell command, not code.
tickets.instrumentation: No instrumentation changes.
tickets.investigation: show-ticket-context.js is 738 lines with sections rendered conditionally. The Pipeline Context section (L685) shows resource existence. Target Status should follow a similar pattern: check ticket.targetStubs and ticket.targetCrimes, render a 3-row table. start-ticket.md Step 4 currently says 'identify stubs that have become resolvable with this ticket (e.g., dependency tickets completed)' with no concrete command — the AI must figure out to grep STUBs and cross-reference with Tickets.json.
tickets.boyScoutPlan: Boy Scout: show-ticket-context.js has several conditionally-rendered sections. The new Target Status section should follow the same pattern (guard at start, blank line before, consistent formatting).

contracts.precondition: Ticket has targetStubs or targetCrimes field (array or 'verified_empty' string)
contracts.postcondition: show-ticket-context output includes a ## Target Status section with stub count and crime count
contracts.invariant: The section is conditionally rendered — absent when neither field exists on the ticket

tickets.title: --ticket-ref パラメータの説明改善: 未来方向（resolve-by）の明確化とパラメータ名変更
tickets.background:
### Goal
insert-stub.js の --ticket-ref パラメータが、来歴（provenance）ではなく解決責任（resolve-by direction）を示すことが即座に理解できるようにする。誤った方向での使用による targetStubs の誤割り当てを根絶する。

### Purpose
現在の "Existing ticket key in Tickets.json" という説明は方向性が中立であり、開発者が「このチケットの作業中に書かれた」という過去方向と「このチケットが将来解決する」という未来方向を区別できない。この曖昧性は enumerate-ticket-targets.js の classifyStubs() が marker 内の ticketRef を ownTicketKey と比較する設計と衝突し、誤った targetStubs 割り当てを引き起こす。

### Motivation
会話中の分析で、--ticket-ref=P3-1 と書かれた STUB が P3-1 の targetStubs に登録され、P3-1 がスコープ外の解決を強制されるシナリオが確認された。これは実際に発生するとシステムの進行を止める重大な問題である。

### Constraints
- insertStub() 関数の内部シグネチャ（ticketRef パラメータ名）は変更しない（既存の全呼び出し元との互換性維持）
- find-stubs-with-ticket-ref.js など別スクリプトの --ticket-ref とは衝突しない（別のコンテキスト）
- 旧 --ticket-ref CLI 引数の拒否は insert-stub.js の parseArgs() 内でのみ行う（他スクリプトは変更しない）

3b. 旧 --ticket-ref が指定された場合は明確なエラーメッセージで新しいパラメータ名を案内するフォールバック処理
4. insert-stub.js の内部変数名 ticketRef は維持（互換性のため）

**Scope of changes:**
  - [Path: .claude/commands/plan-ticket.md / start-ticket.md / review-ticket.md / resolve-ticket.md]
  - [Action: modify]
  - [Detail: insert-stub.js のヘルプコメントブロック内の --ticket-ref 説明と prose 中の --ticket-ref= 参照を --resolve-by-ticket= に変更し、説明文に「将来解決する」方向を明示]

  - [insert-stub.js の内部変数名 ticketRef] — 関数シグネチャは互換性維持のために変更しない
  - [insertStub() 関数の export シグネチャ] — Node.js API としての insertStub({ticketRef}) は維持

tickets.background:
find-omissionsパイプラインの再設計に伴い、STUBが残存しているチケットと未レビューチケットを統合的に検出する仕組みが必要。本チケットでは(1) Tickets.jsonのチケットスキーマにfromStub(boolean)とstubs(配列)フィールドを追加し、(2) find-all-stubs.jsの出力からSTUB付きチケットキーを収集し、Tickets.jsonのreviewed以外の全チケットキーとマージして_tmp-omissions-<timestamp>.jsonに出力するスクリプトを作成する。

### Goal
完了済みチケットにSTUBが残存しているケースとレビュー未了チケットを統合検出し、_tmp-omissions.json として出力するパイプラインを構築する

### Purpose
find-omissions の再設計において、「STUBが放置された完了チケット」と「そもそもレビューが通っていないチケット」の両方を一元的に把握する出発点とする

### Motivation
現在の find-all-stubs.js はSTUBマーカーのみを検出し、未レビューチケットの情報と結合できない。再設計パイプラインの Step 1 として両者を統合するスクリプトが不可欠

### Constraints
- find-all-stubs.js の出力形式（{success, count, stubs[]}）に依存する
- Tickets.json のスキーマは変更可能だが、既存フィールドの削除・リネームは禁止
- 出力ファイル名には実行時のタイムスタンプを YYYYMMDDhhmmss 形式で含める

tickets.background:
find-omissionsパイプラインの再設計に伴い、reviewedチケットの実装が契約を満たしているかを検査する仕組みが必要。本チケットではTickets.jsonから全reviewedチケットのチケットキーを収集し、_tmp-check-target-tickets-cmds-<timestamp>.jsonに検査コマンドリストを生成するスクリプトを作成する。各エントリは {done: false, cmd: 'node ...'} の形式を持ち、初期状態は全てdone=falseとする。

### Goal
reviewed チケット全件に対応する show-ticket-context.js 呼び出しコマンドリストを生成し、Step 3 の検査パイプラインに渡す

### Purpose
Step 3（AIによる実装状況検査）の入力データを準備する。検査対象チケットの列挙とコマンド形式の標準化を自動化し、検査漏れを防止する

### Motivation
現在133件の reviewed チケットを手動で列挙することは現実的でない。また、各チケットのコマンド形式を統一しないと Step 3 の自動実行が不可能

### Constraints
- show-ticket-context.js の CLI インターフェース（--ticket-key, --for-spec）に依存する
- 生成されるコマンドはシェルで直接実行可能な形式である必要がある
- 出力ファイル名には YYYYMMDDhhmmss 形式のタイムスタンプが必要

tickets.background:
For find-omissions pipeline redesign, two existing scripts need minor modifications:

### Goal
Ensure find-omissions Step 3 (now integrated Step 1) produces inspection commands with correct flags and displays remanded ticket status.

### Purpose
The --no-implementation-order flag reduces show-ticket-context.js output by suppressing the Implementation Order reference block. The [!] symbol distinguishes remanded tickets from other statuses in the phase listing.

### Motivation
Without --no-implementation-order, the inspected contract is obscured by 70+ lines of Implementation Order boilerplate, making AI inspection harder. Without [!], the operator cannot tell which tickets have been sent back for re-inspection.

### Constraints
- No changes to existing status symbols (todo/made/planned/done/reviewed). Only add remanded.
- No breaking changes to existing buildCommand() output format. Only append flag.
- Both scripts must remain CommonJS (no ESM migration).

tickets.title: Create add-omission-ticket.js for appending omission tickets to _tmp-omissions.json
tickets.background:
When AI inspection in the find-omissions pipeline finds a ticket whose contracts are not satisfied by tests (criteria A/B/C), the finding must be recorded as a new omission ticket in _tmp-omissions-*.json.

### Goal
Provide a structural quality gate for appending omission tickets — every appended ticket must match /make-ticket level precision.

### Purpose
Prevent the find loop from diverging. A sloppy omission ticket inherits the same defect it was meant to catch, so the script must validate structural completeness before writing.

### Motivation
Without this gate, AI-inspected omission tickets would vary in quality, causing re-inspection churn and pipeline divergence.

### Constraints
- Must not modify existing tickets in _tmp-omissions. Only append.
- Must not depend on external services (no HTTP, no AI). Pure Node.js file I/O.
- Must preserve Tickets.json schema compatibility.
scope: Create add-omission-ticket.js at .claude/scripts/tickets/add-omission-ticket.js
Accept --tmp-omissions=<path> and ticket JSON via stdin
Parse stdin as a ticket object and validate all required fields (title, background, scope, testUnit, acceptanceCriteria, invariants, contracts if applicable)
Append the valid ticket to the PX phase (phaseId=-1) of _tmp-omissions-*.json
If _tmp-omissions-*.json does not exist, create it from Tickets.json schema template
Reject tickets missing required fields with a clear error message
Reject empty scope/testUnit/acceptanceCriteria arrays
Preserve all existing tickets in _tmp-omissions-*.json when appending
Ensure the appended ticket has fromStub=false and stubs=[]
Output the updated file path on success

  - [Before → After] N/A (new file)

tickets.background:
The find-omissions pipeline needs a unified orchestrator script that:

1. Internally ensures _tmp-omissions-*.json exists (runs create-tmp-omissions.js if missing)
2. Internally ensures _tmp-check-target-tickets-cmds-*.json exists (runs create-check-target-tickets-cmds.js if missing)
3. Pops the first done:false entry, marks it done:true, sets ticket status to remanded in Tickets.json
4. Actually executes show-ticket-context.js with --for-spec --no-implementation-order
5. Prefixes stdout with progress message in English
6. Supports --with-clean-trash flag to delete tmp files when all entries are done

### Goal
Create a one-command entry point for AI-inspecting all reviewed tickets.

### Purpose
Eliminate the need for the operator to manually orchestrate 3 separate scripts.

### Motivation
The previous design required 3 separate steps with manual handoffs. Steps 1 and 2 are mechanical preconditions for Step 3, so they should be automatic.

### Constraints
- Must NOT modify existing scripts. Only invoke as child processes.
- Must preserve JSON-based tmp file protocol.
- Must remain CommonJS.
- Flags must match existing conventions.

tickets.background:
The find-omissions pipeline needs three remaining pieces to be complete:

### Goal
Add structured foundOmissions field to ticket schema, enhance add-omission-ticket.js to copy original tickets, and create a merge command to finalize omission tickets into Tickets.json.

### Purpose
Without foundOmissions, omission details are stored as unstructured notes, making them unverifiable and prone to divergence during re-inspection.

### Motivation
The current pipeline stops at _tmp-omissions-*.json generation but cannot merge findings back into Tickets.json. This blocks the implementation loop.

### Constraints
- foundOmissions schema must be identical in Tickets.json and _tmp-omissions-*.json.
- add-omission-ticket.js must remain backward-compatible (stdin-only mode unchanged).
- Merge must never overwrite existing Tickets.json tickets.
- All scripts remain CommonJS, no external deps.

The find-omissions pipeline has three structural deficiencies:

### Goal
Enable the AI to record omission findings one at a time, as they are discovered, without batching or memory dependency.

### Purpose
The current flat foundOmissions schema forces the AI to batch all findings or create redundant clones. Both approaches increase the risk of omission loss.

### Motivation
During real usage, omissions are discovered one contract/criterion at a time while tracing source code. The tool must support this discovery pattern, not fight it.

- No breaking changes to existing CLI interface (stdin mode unchanged).
- No changes to merge-omissions-to-tickets.js (already handles foundOmissions as opaque array).

PX-104 implemented evidence.codes but made the wrong design choice.

### Goal
Fix the evidence design: AI provides line, script extracts codes from the actual source file.

### Purpose
AI naturally knows the line number from source analysis. Requiring codes forces the AI to manually copy code into JSON, which is error-prone and wasteful. The script should automate this extraction.

### Motivation
During real /find-omissions usage, the AI reads source files and identifies problematic lines. It should provide those line numbers, and the script should read the actual file content at those lines. This is exactly the pattern already used in create-tmp-omissions.js extractCodes().

### Constraints
- extractCodes() must match create-tmp-omissions.js behavior (read 3 lines from file at line).
- File paths are resolved relative to CWD (same as create-tmp-omissions.js).
- If the file does not exist or cannot be read, the script must error out — no silent fallback.

tickets.title: Inspection Sentinel Idempotency — Prevent prefix accumulation across find-omissions cycles
tickets.background:
### Goal
Provide idempotent prefix prepending across create-tmp-omissions.js and add-omission-ticket.js so that running /find-omissions any number of times never accumulates duplicate REJECTION_WARNING or ABC_INSPECTION_PREFIX text in ticket backgrounds.

### Purpose
The find-omissions pipeline runs repeatedly (one cycle per implementation pass). Without idempotency, each cycle appends a new copy of the inspection warning text, causing backgrounds to grow unboundedly. This fix is prerequisite infrastructure for multi-pass find-omissions workflows.

### Motivation
The OMISSIONS to phasify to merge to re-implement to re-inspect loop is the core re-implementation pipeline. Without sentinel-based idempotency, this loop is limited to a single iteration before backgrounds become corrupted. The need is immediate: the second find-omissions cycle on siprs will trigger this bug.

### Constraints
- Must use startsWith() for detection (no regex, no substring search). Must not modify the signature or behavior of any existing public API. Must be backward compatible with OMISSIONS-*.json files generated before this fix. Must not require changes to Tickets.json schema.

define INSPECTION_SENTINEL = "[::INSPECTION_FLAGGED::]" in add-omission-ticket.js, export via module.exports
add repairDuplicateSentinels(background) pure function — strips all but last occurrence of INSPECTION_SENTINEL
add countInspectionSentinels(background) pure function — for diagnostics

tickets.background:
### Goal
Create phasify-omissions.js that reads OMISSIONS-YYYYMMDDhhmmss.json, RFC-ROOT-GRAPH.json, and Tickets.json, applies the identical 5-phase mathematical pipeline (Tarjan SCC → Kahn topological sort → soft constraint costing → phase merging with hard constraint enforcement → consolidation) used by phasify-graph-and-dirs-files-tree.js, and outputs OMISSIONS-phasified-YYYYMMDDhhmmss.json with correct dependency-ordered phases for re-implementation tickets.

### Purpose
OMISSIONS files retain original Tickets.json phase structure designed for initial implementation, not for re-implementation of a subset of nodes. The omission subset (53 of 67 nodes, 21 hard edges) has different dependency characteristics.

### Motivation
The find-omissions to phasify to merge to implement to re-inspect loop is the core re-implementation pipeline for siprs. The first cycle produced OMISSIONS-20260730133520.json with 5 action tickets not mathematically optimized.

### Constraints
- Must not modify phasify-helpers.js or boundify-helpers.js. Must produce output compatible with Tickets.json schema. Must compute phase ID offset dynamically from current Tickets.json. Must handle cross-boundary edges correctly. minSize auto-calculated as max(3, min(10, ceil(totalNodes/7))).

tickets.title: phasify-omissions auto-merge: backup, validate, atomic Tickets.json update, --dry-run
tickets.background:
Goal: phasify-omissions.js が OMISSIONS-phasified-*.json 出力後、Tickets.json へのバックアップ・マージ・検証・原子書き込み・クリーンアップまでを一貫して自動実行し、ゴミファイルを残さないこと。

Purpose: 手動マージによるヒューマンエラー（Tickets.json 破損、ゴミファイル残留）を排除し、phasify→merge パイプラインを信頼性高く自動化する。

Motivation: PX-107 で phasify は完成したが、その後のマージは手動運用だった。実運用で繰り返し使うには完全自動化が必須。

Constraints:
- Tickets.json は常にバックアップ後にのみ書き換える
- 書き換えは atomic write（tmp書込み → rename）で行う
- すべての一時ファイル（tmp-Tickets-*.json, OMISSIONS-phasified-*.json）は処理完了後に必ず削除する
- --dry-run 時は一切のファイル書込み・削除を行わない
scope: 【変更1】バックアップ: runPhasifyOmissions() に backupTickets() を追加。Tickets.json を tmp-Tickets-{YYYYMMDDhhmmss}.json にコピー。
【変更2】マージ: mergePhasifyToTickets() を追加。phasified phases を in-memory の Tickets.json コピーにマージ。referenceTickets は除去。

【変更4】Atomic write: tmp ファイルに書込→rename パターンで Tickets.json を安全に上書き。
【変更5】クリーンアップ: cleanupFiles() を追加。OMISSIONS-phasified-*.json と tmp-Tickets-*.json を削除。
【変更6】dry-run 拡張: 既存 --dry-run でマージをメモリ内実行し検証まで行い、結果表示して終了。
【変更7】全新規関数を export + テスト追加。

tickets.investigation:
**Key source code patterns identified:**

**1. merge-omissions-to-tickets.js** (.claude/scripts/tickets/)
  - reassignIds(grouped, ticketsData): finds max(existing phase IDs) + 1 for ID conflict avoidance
  - mergeToTickets(ticketsData, omissionsData): validates -> groups -> reassigns -> appends
  - Direct fs.writeFileSync overwrite (no atomic write)
  - **Pattern to borrow**: reassignIds() ticket ID conflict resolution logic

**2. merge-contracts-to-tickets.js** (.claude/scripts/tickets/)
  - atomicWrite(targetPath, data): writes to tmp file then fs.renameSync
  - **Pattern to borrow**: atomicWrite() pattern verbatim

**3. phasify-omissions.js** (.claude/scripts/rfc-graph/)
  - Current runPhasifyOmissions() ends at Step J (write OMISSIONS-phasified-*.json)
  - --dry-run already exists and skips file write
  - opts object already carries: omissionsPath, graphPath, ticketsPath, outputPath, dryRun, verbose
  - All phasify data is in-memory before Step J
  - buildOutput() produces the phasified output structure
  - **No existing merge-back logic** -- all new

**4. lib/validate-tickets.js** (.claude/scripts/lib/)
  - validateTickets(data) validates the full Tickets.json structure
  - Checks: title, metadata.source, metadata.generatedAt, phases[].id, phases[].name, tickets[].id, tickets[].phaseId, tickets[].title, tickets[].status, contracts, array fields
  - **Pattern to borrow**: require() and call validateTickets() directly

**5. Phase ID safety**: phasified output uses offset = max(existing) + 1 -- no collision with existing phases
**6. Reference tickets**: already originals in Tickets.json -- safe to strip on merge
tickets.boyScoutPlan:
**Translatability improvements for phasify-omissions.js:**

1. **Extract merge pipeline into named functions** (all new):
   - backupTickets(sourcePath, ts) -> creates tmp-Tickets-{ts}.json
   - mergePhasifyToTickets(ticketsData, phasifiedOutput) -> pure merge function
   - validateMergedTickets(mergedData) -> wraps lib/validate-tickets.js
   - atomicWrite(targetPath, data) -> tmp+rename pattern
   - cleanupFiles(paths) -> deterministic cleanup

   Each function is a verb phrase, making the pipeline in runPhasifyOmissions() read as: backup -> merge -> validate -> atomicWrite -> cleanup.

2. **No existing code modification** -- all new functions added as exports, existing exports preserved.

3. **Hardcoded pattern extraction**: OMISSIONS-phasified filename pattern extracted to a named constant for use by cleanupFiles().

contracts.precondition: mergePhasifyToTickets() accepts: (originalTickets: object, phasifiedOutput: object) where phasifiedOutput has shape {title, metadata, phases[], referenceTickets?}
contracts.postcondition: Returns deep-cloned originalTickets with phasifiedOutput.phases appended (referenceTickets stripped). Returns {success: true, data: merged} or throws TypeError on invalid input.
contracts.invariant: All originalTickets.phases[*] entries are deep-equal before and after merge. No mutation of input arguments.

contracts.precondition: backupTickets() accepts: (sourcePath: string, targetPath: string) where sourcePath is readable JSON file
contracts.postcondition: If successful: targetPath contains a byte-for-byte identical copy of sourcePath. Returns {success: true, backupPath: targetPath}. If sourcePath not found: throws Error.
contracts.invariant: backupTickets() never modifies the source file. File permissions of source are preserved on copy.

contracts.precondition: Accepts: (mergedData: object). MergedData must be parseable JSON with shape {title, metadata, phases[]}.
contracts.postcondition: Returns {valid: boolean, errors: string[]} where errors is populated iff valid===false. Delegates to lib/validate-tickets.js validateTickets().
contracts.invariant: validateMergedTickets() is a pure function — same input always produces same output. Never throws on well-structured data.

contracts.precondition: atomicWrite() accepts: (targetPath: string, data: string). targetPath must be writable. Data must be valid UTF-8.
contracts.postcondition: Intermediate tmp file (targetPath.tmp.{pid}) is created then atomically renamed to targetPath via fs.renameSync. On failure: tmp file is NOT cleaned up (caller responsibility). TargetPath is never partially written.
contracts.invariant: fs.renameSync is atomic on the same POSIX filesystem — readers always see either old complete file or new complete file.

contracts.precondition: cleanupFiles() accepts: (paths: string[]). Each entry is an absolute file path to delete.
contracts.postcondition: Each path is unlinked if it exists. Non-existent paths are silently skipped. Returns void.
contracts.invariant: cleanupFiles() never throws on ENOENT. Never deletes files outside the explicit paths array.

contracts.precondition: All phasify pipeline steps (A-I) execute normally. Output is computed but NOT written to disk.
contracts.postcondition: No fs.writeFileSync / fs.renameSync / fs.unlinkSync calls are made. Validation result is printed to stdout. Exit code: 0 (pass) or 1 (fail).
contracts.invariant: Tickets.json on disk is byte-identical before and after dry-run. No OMISSIONS-phasified-*.json or tmp-Tickets-*.json files are created.

planTestCode: // C001-PRE: mergePhasifyToTickets() -- valid input
const ticketsData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('Tickets.json', 'utf8'));

const phasified = { title: 'test', metadata: { source: 'test', generatedAt: '2026-07-30' }, phases: [{ id: 22, name: 'P22', nodeIds: ['N0001'], tickets: [{ id: 1, phaseId: 22, title: 'Test ticket', status: 'todo', contracts: [] }] }], referenceTickets: [{ id: 99, phaseId: 0, title: 'Reference' }] };
const result = mergePhasifyToTickets(ticketsData, phasified);
assert.ok(result.success, 'merge succeeds');
assert.strictEqual(result.data.phases.length, ticketsData.phases.length + 1, 'one phase appended');
// C001-POST: referenceTickets stripped, no mutation
const appendedPhase = result.data.phases[result.data.phases.length - 1];
assert.strictEqual(appendedPhase.id, 22, 'phase ID preserved');
assert.strictEqual(result.data.referenceTickets, undefined, 'referenceTickets stripped');
assert.deepStrictEqual(result.data.phases.slice(0, -1), ticketsData.phases, 'original phases unchanged');
// C001-INV: TypeError on invalid input
assert.throws(() => mergePhasifyToTickets(null, {}), { name: 'TypeError' }, 'null tickets throws');
assert.throws(() => mergePhasifyToTickets({}, null), { name: 'TypeError' }, 'null phasified throws');
// C002-PRE: backupTickets() -- valid copy
const tmpPath = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'tmp-Tickets-test.json');
const backupResult = backupTickets('Tickets.json', tmpPath);
assert.ok(backupResult.success, 'backup succeeds');
assert.ok(fs.existsSync(tmpPath), 'backup file exists');
const original = fs.readFileSync('Tickets.json', 'utf8');
const backup = fs.readFileSync(tmpPath, 'utf8');
assert.strictEqual(original, backup, 'byte-for-byte identical');
fs.unlinkSync(tmpPath);
// C002-ERR: backupTickets() throws on nonexistent source
assert.throws(() => backupTickets('/nonexistent/path.json', tmpPath), 'throws on missing source');
// C003-PRE: validateMergedTickets() -- valid data
const validData = { title: 't', metadata: { source: 's', generatedAt: '2026-07-30' }, phases: [{ id: 0, name: 'P0', tickets: [{ id: 1, phaseId: 0, title: 'x', status: 'todo' }] }] };
const validResult = validateMergedTickets(validData);
assert.ok(validResult.valid, 'valid data passes');
assert.strictEqual(validResult.errors.length, 0, 'no errors');
// C003-ERR: invalid data fails
const invalidResult = validateMergedTickets({});
assert.strictEqual(invalidResult.valid, false, 'invalid fails');
assert.ok(invalidResult.errors.length > 0, 'errors populated');
// C004-PRE: atomicWrite() -- tmp+rename pattern
const targetPath = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atomic-test.json');
const content = JSON.stringify({ test: true });
atomicWrite(targetPath, content);
assert.ok(fs.existsSync(targetPath), 'target exists');
assert.strictEqual(fs.readFileSync(targetPath, 'utf8'), content, 'content matches');
fs.unlinkSync(targetPath);
// C005-PRE: cleanupFiles() deletes specified files
const f1 = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'cleanup-test-1.tmp');
const f2 = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'cleanup-test-2.tmp');
fs.writeFileSync(f1, ''); fs.writeFileSync(f2, '');
cleanupFiles([f1, f2]);
assert.strictEqual(fs.existsSync(f1), false, 'f1 deleted');
assert.strictEqual(fs.existsSync(f2), false, 'f2 deleted');
// C005-EDGE: nonexistent paths silently ignored
assert.doesNotThrow(() => cleanupFiles(['/nonexistent/path.tmp']), 'ENOENT silently ignored');
// C006: --dry-run -- no files written
// Patch fs.writeFileSync and verify zero calls
const writeCalls = [];
const origWrite = fs.writeFileSync;
fs.writeFileSync = (...args) => { writeCalls.push(args[0]); };
// runPhasifyOmissions({ ...opts, dryRun: true });
// assert.strictEqual(writeCalls.length, 0, 'no files written in dry-run');
fs.writeFileSync = origWrite;

tickets.title: phasify-omissions --rollback: deterministic phase rollback from Tickets.json
tickets.background:
Goal: phasify-omissions.js --rollback フラグで、直前にマージしたフェーズを Tickets.json から決定論的に除去できること。

Purpose: 誤マージ時の安全な復元手段を提供する。バックアップファイルからの手動復元に依存しない。

Motivation: PX-108 で自動マージが可能になったが、ロールバック手段がない。決定論的アルゴリズムなら機械的ロールバックが可能。

Constraints:
- ロールバックは追加されたフェーズのみを除去。既存フェーズは一切変更しない
- マージ情報（offset）は Tickets.json metadata に永続化する
- --dry-run と組み合わせて削除プレビュー可能
- ロールバック後も再マージ可能
scope: Tickets.json metadata 拡張: phasify-omissions がマージ時に metadata.phasifyMerge に {offset, mergedPhaseIds, mergedAt} を書き込む
--rollback 解析: parseArguments() に --rollback フラグを追加
rollbackPhasifyMerge() 実装: Tickets.json を読み込み metadata.phasifyMerge.offset 以上の phase.id を phases から除去、該当 phaseId のチケットを全チケットから除去、metadata.phasifyMerge を削除
--rollback --dry-run 対応: 削除対象のフェーズ一覧を表示して終了（ファイル書き込みなし）
エラーハンドリング: metadata.phasifyMerge 不在時はエラー終了、既存フェーズとの整合性検証
全テスト追加

tickets.title: phasify-omissions.js 欠陥修正 — 全チケット・全フィールドの欠損ゼロ再配置
tickets.background:
Current phasify-omissions.js has three critical defects that cause data loss when processing _tmp-omissions-*.json:
1. dedupTickets() separates tickets into actionTickets (originalTicketKey present) and referenceTickets (no originalTicketKey). Reference tickets are excluded from phase reallocation entirely, so 20 of 21 tickets never get new phase assignments.
2. consolidatePhasesByTicketCount() merges phases with fewer than 3 tickets, destroying ticket-to-phase mappings. Only phase splitting and reordering are permitted — ticket consolidation is prohibited.
3. buildOutput() uses a whitelist that drops fromStub, stubs, and many other fields. Tickets must be passed through with all fields intact (JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(t)) deep clone).
The phase ID offset mechanism (computePhaseIdOffset → reassignPhaseIdsWithOffset) is correct and must be preserved.

### Goal
Eliminate data loss in phasify-omissions.js so that every ticket and field from _tmp-omissions-*.json is preserved in the output.

### Purpose
Ensures that /find-omissions → phasify-omissions delivers complete data to Tickets.json without information loss, enabling correct downstream processing.

### Motivation

tickets.title: Round-aware ticket status: encode R<round> in markPreMergeTicketsReviewed and increment round
tickets.background:
### Goal
Record which round each ticket was completed in by encoding ticket status as 'R' + round (R1, R2, ...) instead of erasing that information with the generic 'reviewed' value, and advance the Tickets.json round field by 1 after each phasify-omissions merge so the next round starts with an incremented round number.

### Purpose
The round concept (1st round, 2nd round, 3rd round ...) is born from the pipeline graphify -> boundify -> split (upstream), then make -> plan -> start -> review -> resolve (implementation), then /find-omissions -> next round. When phasify-omissions merges omissions, it currently overwrites ALL pre-merge tickets' status to 'reviewed', losing which round each ticket finished in. Encoding R<round> preserves per-round completion history so a ticket finished in round 1 reads 'R1', round 2 reads 'R2', etc., while still being recognized as processed by every status consumer.

### Motivation
The round field was added to Tickets.json (fixed value 1 on new creation) as the counter for this cycle. Without the R<round> status encoding, the round number would be dead data — nothing would ever record or consume it. This ticket makes the round field meaningful end-to-end and prepares the pipeline for multi-round operation.

### Constraints
- 'R<round>' is written ONLY by phasify-omissions during merge; interactive transitions keep the existing ALLOWED status set
- Tickets.json is created with round: 1 fixed; edits never touch round (only the merge flow increments it)
- All 5 project roots (root, tools/conver, crates/siprs, crates/anthropx, crates/ggufrs) carry their own copies of the affected scripts; identical changes must be applied to every copy
- Rollback (PX-109) does not restore pre-merge statuses nor decrement round — an accepted limitation

- [Internal state invariant] pre-merge tickets (phase.id < offset) are uniformly marked 'R' + round while newly added omission tickets (phase.id >= offset) remain 'todo'
- [Boundary invariant] round is always an integer >= 1 and remains >= 1 after increment

tickets.title: phasify-omissions.js — Step 5-3 フェーズ統合の正しい復活（consolidation + re-index IDs）
tickets.background:
PX-113 は consolidatePhasesByTicketCount() を完全に無効化したが、split-to-tickets.md Step 5-3 の不変条件「全フェーズ3チケット以上」を満たすには正しい形で統合を復活させる必要がある。

### Goal
split-to-tickets.md Step 5-3 と同一アルゴリズムで、3チケット未満のフェーズを後方マージで統合し、出力の全フェーズを3チケット以上にする。統合後のチケットIDはフェーズ内で一意な連番（re-index IDs）を保証する。

### Purpose
find-omissions → phasify-omissions パイプラインが /split-to-tickets と同一のフェーズ構造不変条件（≥3チケット）を満たすようにする。PX-113 が統合を無効化した根因（マージ後のID再採番欠落）を修正することで、過剰修正だった「統合禁止」を撤回できる。

### Motivation
crates/siprs で /find-omissions を実行した際、P8〜P11 が各1チケットのまま Tickets.json にマージされた。これは Step 5-3 の不変条件違反であり、チケット粒度が過小なフェーズが残る実害を伴う。ユーザーは「3つ未満のチケットしかないフェーズは統合」のアルゴリズムとの同一性を要求している。

### Constraints
修正は ~/shyme/zasso/tools/conver 内に限定し、siprs へは install.js（cd tools/conver && node install.js -y -t ~/shyme/zasso/crates/siprs/.claude）で配布する。crates/siprs/Tickets.json は手作業で書き換えず、スクリプト（--rollback → 修正済み phasify-omissions 再実行）のみで修正する。この再実行を本改修の最終テストとして用いる。phasify-helpers.js の5フェーズアルゴリズムと外部インターフェースは変更しない。

tickets.notes:
tools/conver 内にのみ修正し、install.js で siprs に配布する。siprs Tickets.json は手作業で書き換えず、scripts（--rollback スナップショット復元 → 再実行）のみで修正する。この再実行を phasify-omissions.js 改修の最終テストとする。

- [Implementation steps] ① tools/conver で TDD Red（統合検証テストとロールバック検証テストを先に書き、現在の実装で RED を確認）→ ② Step G 復活 + re-index IDs 実装 → ③ --rollback をスナップショット復元方式へ変更（metadata.phasifyMerge.snapshotPath・timestamp 追記 + rollbackPhasifyMerge 置換）→ ④ テスト修正 → ⑤ tools/conver で全テスト GREEN → ⑥ install.js で siprs にインストール → ⑦ siprs Tickets.json を --rollback でスナップショット復元（tickets/Tickets-20260731115931.json を上書き）→ ⑧ 修正済み phasify-omissions を omissions/OMISSIONS-20260731115931.json に対して再実行 → ⑨ make list-tickets で P6,P7,P8(4) を確認
- [Risks] 再実行により round が 1→2 に進む（スナップショット復元後は round=1）。マージ後の ID 再採番を実装し忘れると統合フェーズ内でチケットIDが衝突する。ハードエッジ制約によって一部マージがスキップされる可能性がある。tickets/ に複数スナップショットがある場合、無条件に「最新」を選ぶと再ロールバックが巻き戻し不能になるため、必ず metadata.phasifyMerge のポインタ（snapshotPath → timestamp）で解決する
- [Caveats] 修正対象は tools/conver 内のみ。siprs の Tickets.json・OMISSIONS アーティファクトは手で編集しない。OMISSIONS-phasified-*.json は再実行で上書きされるため、必要なら事前に退避する。--rollback はスナップショットを上書きコピーするため、--with-backup で現状を退避してから実行する
- [Open items] 全ての末尾フェーズが3未満の場合、最終フェーズ除外ルールにより末尾フェーズが吸収先になる（siprs のケースでは P11 が吸収 → 再採番で P8）。この挙動が期待と一致することを実データで確認する
